title: Chole (Chana Masala)
description: Chickpeas cooked in a tangy, spiced onion-tomato gravy — a North Indian favourite, classically served with Bhature or steamed rice.

ingredients.name: Tea Bag
ingredients.notes: optional, for colour, tied in a muslin cloth

steps: Drain the soaked chickpeas and add to a pressure cooker with the water and the tea bag (if using). Cook for 6-7 whistles, until completely soft. Discard the tea bag.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and sauté the onions until deep golden brown, about 10 minutes.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and cook for a minute, then add the tomato puree and cook until the oil separates, about 8-10 minutes.
Add the chole masala, red chilli powder, turmeric and salt, and cook for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the cooked chickpeas along with their cooking liquid and the slit green chillies. Simmer, partially covered, for 15-20 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken the gravy.
Stir in the amchur if using. Adjust salt and consistency, then garnish with coriander leaves before serving.
